business_problem: David's Bridal needed to move beyond dress search and static vendor directories so it could understand each couple's visual preferences, connect them with the right vendors, and reduce the friction and stress of wedding planning.
solution_summary: David's Bridal built Pearl Planner and VendorConnect on Google Cloud to turn wedding planning into a visually guided, AI-assisted marketplace. Google Cloud Vision AI analyzes images selected by each bride to extract design attributes and build a preference graph that captures style intent across venues, decor, florals, dresses, and wedding-party looks. Those visual insights feed VendorConnect, where Google Cloud Search APIs match couples with nearby businesses that fit their aesthetic and timing needs, and Gemini turns email exchanges into to-do lists and calendar updates to simplify follow-through. Cloud Run and related product tooling give teams room to prototype and launch new consumer features quickly, while additional AI tools help non-engineers move from concept to production. Data from Pearl Planner also flows to in-store stylists, giving them rich customer context before fittings and tying digital personalization back to showroom experiences.

data_flow: Couples share visual inspiration, Vision AI extracts themes into a preference graph, Search APIs map those preferences to nearby vendors, Gemini organizes communications and tasks, and the resulting profile data flows into in-store stylist workflows so digital and physical planning stay connected.
business_outcome: Pearl Planner tripled engagement over legacy experiences, brought one third of users back each week, enriched personalization for both digital and store channels, and let David's Bridal price VendorConnect 30% to 40% below competing services.
